# Yon Zilch

> This is Yonzilch's blog

This file is a curated Markdown map of the site for large language models. Use the links below as canonical entry points for understanding the site, its posts, projects, pages, and related resources.

## Core

- [Home](https://blog.yon.im/): Homepage and primary site entry point.
- [Posts](https://blog.yon.im/posts): Blog post index.
- [Projects](https://blog.yon.im/projects): Project showcase index.
- [Links](https://blog.yon.im/links): Friend links and external resources.
- [Tags](https://blog.yon.im/tags): Taxonomies index.
- [Sitemap](https://blog.yon.im/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for crawlable pages.
- [RSS](https://blog.yon.im/rss.xml): RSS feed (RSS 2.0)
- [RSS](https://blog.yon.im/atom.xml): Atom feed (Atom 1.0)

## Projects

- [EFI-Q1HY-OpenCore-Hackintosh](https://blog.yon.im/projects/EFI-Q1HY-OpenCore-Hackintosh): Sequoia, Sonoma, Ventura tested. Archive myself hackintosh EFI config for Q1HY.
- [arata](https://blog.yon.im/projects/arata): A modern and minimalistic blog theme powered by Gleam and Lustre.
- [FYOM](https://blog.yon.im/projects/fyom): For Your Own Media: A lightweight, self-hosted media catalog — no transcoding, no scraping, no fuss.
- [OpenYZLab](https://blog.yon.im/projects/openyzlab): A set of self-hosted services, maintaining as long as I can.
- [SAIG](https://blog.yon.im/projects/saig): Static Assets Index Generator: Automatically generates beautiful, styled directory listings for your local files.
- [SRRM](https://blog.yon.im/projects/srrm): Serverless Repository Release Monitor: Track releases across multiple Git repositories in one place.
- [VexGo](https://blog.yon.im/projects/vexgo): A lightweight, self-hosted blog content management system designed for developers and writers who value simplicity, performance, and control.
- [YonOS](https://blog.yon.im/projects/yonos): A Nix and Flakes❄️ based config set customized with Occam's razor.
- [yzlab](https://blog.yon.im/projects/yzlab): OpenYZLab Infra: My personal Infrastructure Lab, fully declarative and reproducible — powered by NixOS Flakes.
